name: a system diagram builds itself edge by edge
looks: A headline claims the same idea is quick to see. Below it a small architecture diagram builds itself live: a line draws from one labelled box out to the next, the new box fades in the instant the line lands, branching out from a single entry point into several services and their stores.
build: Nodes at fixed precomputed layout coordinates; each edge strokes on with strokeDashoffset (power2.out); the target node fades/scales in once its edge lands; one edge at a time in sequence, branching outward.
sound: A soft tick per edge connecting, a slightly brighter tick when a node lands.
prompt: Claim that the same idea is quick to see, then build a small system diagram live underneath: a line draws from one box to the next, the new box fading in the instant it lands, branching out from a single entry point until the whole diagram sits connected.
